--- updatedAt: 2026-03-13T16:19:44.000Z agentTools: siteIndex: https://developer.monday.com/llms.txt projectIndex: https://developer.monday.com/apps/llms.txt --- # Partner Program The monday app marketplace Partner Program helps support and empower our app developers on their journey toward success. Through this initiative, we strive to provide a collaborative community that nurtures innovation, amplifies exposure, and drives mutual growth. With a range of benefits and resources tailored to their unique needs, our Partner Program is the key to unlocking endless possibilities. This guide will walk you through the program requirements, benefits, and how you can become a partner. Let's get started! # Requirements The Marketplace Partner Program is divided into four tiers: *Platinum*, *Gold*, *Silver*, and *Bronze*. In addition to the requirements all apps must fulfill to be listed in the marketplace (see more [here](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/app-review-checklist)), each tier has additional requirements that your app must meet to participate in the program. Below, you can find a full breakdown of the requirements according to tier. | Requirements | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum | | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | | [Apps rating](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/marketplace-app-ratings-and-reviews) | - | 4+ | 4+ | 4.5+ | | [Monetized by monday](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/monetization) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | | Customer Service Level Agreement (SLA) | < 48 hours | < 48 hours | < 24 hours | < 24 hours | | [Security Questionnaire](https://forms.monday.com/forms/1e126005a08c78a19ceac5b810fae8b3?r=use1) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | | Minimum marketplace annual recurring revenue (ARR) from monday.com native monetization | $5K | $75K | $300K | $1M | | Sign [listing agreement](https://monday.com/l/marketplace-developers/monday-com-marketplace-listing-terms/) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | | Complete the [app review process](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/submit-your-app) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | *\*Quarterly performance evaluations will be conducted to ensure that all requirements are met.* # Benefits Now that you know the requirements, you may be wondering what's in it for you. Being a Marketplace Partner comes with a variety of benefits, including help earning higher revenue, more marketing resources, and increased support from the marketplace team as you progress to higher tiers. The table below walks through each benefit that partners get based on their tier.
Benefit category Benefit Bronze Silver Gold Platinum
Economic **Payments & sales reports** Monthly Monthly Monthly Bi-Weekly
Enablement **Marketplace Analytics** Yes Yes Yes Custom
Enablement **Access to the product roadmap** - Yes Yes Closed forum
Enablement **Business review with monday marketplace leadership** - - Yes Yes
Enablement * *Feature request round table** with leading PMs - - Yes Yes
Marketing **Partner badge in the marketplace** (indicates to users that you met advanced requirements) Yes Yes Yes Yes
Marketing **Event participation and sponsorships** Yes Yes Prioritized Prioritized
Marketing * *Marketplace placement** (Marketplace categories, suggestions, and more) - - Prioritized Prioritized
Marketing * *Co-marketing opportunities ** (app launch and ongoing marketing support) - - Prioritized Prioritized
Marketing **Access to sales enablement activities** (The option to join monday’s app introduction webinars, register in the internal directory, and more) - - Yes Yes
Marketing Customer success story - - Yes Yes
Support * *Support response time** (business hours) \< 48 hours \< 48 hours \< 24 hours \< 24 hours
Support * *Partner Success Manager** (a dedicated success manager to accompany you throughout your partnership journey and provide ongoing guidance, support, and valuable product feedback) - - Office hours Dedicated
**Please note** that the marketplace partner program is subject to change, as determined by monday.com, at its sole discretion.
